reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an online earning opportunity and directs viewers to contact the promoter or use a personal link. The dashboard presents income and received BUSD notifications alongside partner, team, level and priority-leader elements, indicating that participation and earnings are tied to recruiting or maintaining a multi-person structure.

opening.argument: Judge, the title calls this an earning platform, but it does not promise viewers a return. The displayed figures are attached to one account; they do not establish what another person would earn. The invitation to contact the creator about online work also gives no deposit amount, guaranteed payout, or instruction to recruit. Treating this as a deceptive earnings promise would require claims the video does not make.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution links an invitation to contact the creator with a dashboard showing partners and payments. That establishes promotional context, but the displayed account does not itself prove that a viewer must pay to join, recruit others to be paid, or expect the same income. Those are consequential steps in the prosecution's interpretation, not terms stated in the invitation.

citations.quote: If you also want to work online, follow me and contact me: [PHONE] bid platform Forsage.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A missing guarantee is not a disclaimer or risk warning. The creator calls Forsage an earning platform and invites viewers to make contact, while the displayed account combines BUSD receipts, a new partner, partner and team counts, and a shareable personal link. The concern is the promoted recruitment-linked earning structure, not solely whether the creator promises every viewer a fixed return.

opening.argument: Judge, much of the visible material is an account interface: a profile, personal link, profit display, partner and team counts, and notifications. Showing those screens can be read as demonstrating what this account displays, not establishing that its figures are attainable by viewers. The audio supplies no spoken investment pitch. Although the description invites contact about online work, it does not explain a payment or enrollment procedure; the concrete video evidence remains a display of an interface.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution reads the notifications as evidence of recruitment-dependent earnings. But a screen containing a new-partner notice and separate BUSD receipts does not explain the rule connecting them. Nor does showing a personal link establish that the viewer is instructed to use it. The opening infers a compensation mechanism from a displayed account without showing that mechanism's terms.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video does more than neutrally display an interface. Its title presents Forsage as an earning platform, and its description invites viewers who want online work to follow and contact the creator. Against that invitation, the account's personal link, join button, BUSD receipts, and partner and team notices function as promotional evidence for participation, even without a spoken explanation of every rule.

opening.argument: Judge, a referral feature and an earning claim are not, by themselves, proof of a fraudulent arrangement. The displayed account has a personal link, partner and team counts, and BUSD notifications, but the supplied material shows no deposit request, credential request, guaranteed return, or stated rule paying the account holder for recruiting others. The description asks interested viewers to contact the creator about online work. On this record, ordinary promotion of an online service remains a possible reading; the specific harmful transaction has not been shown.

citations.quote: If you also want to work online, follow me and contact me: [PHONE] bid platform Forsage.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to levels, partners, a team, and BUSD receipts, but proximity on a dashboard does not establish the conditions for receiving those funds. The contact invitation does not specify a fee or demand sensitive information. A judge can recognize the referral-oriented presentation without treating an unstated payout rule as a demonstrated fact.

citations.quote: If you also want to work online, follow me and contact me: [PHONE] bid platform Forsage.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not an isolated referral feature in an otherwise identified retail transaction. The creator advertises Forsage as an earning platform and solicits contact from people seeking online work. The displayed account pairs level-based BUSD receipts with a new-partner notification, partner and team counts, a personal link, and a join prompt. The absence of an explicit deposit instruction does not erase that recruitment-oriented earnings pitch.
